chunks: "No," said (the father). "You have made up the story; but patience is best; God may bring them back to me. He is all-knowing and all-wise."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Sabr Jamil' in the story of Prophet Jacob?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (Ya'qub) counters his sons' report by attributing their error to the self (nafs), a concept central to Shia spiritual psychology regarding the ego's tendency to deceive. His declaration of 'beautiful patience' (sabr jamil) highlights the virtue of enduring hardship with grace and without complaint, while his hope for reunion rests on Allah's attributes of All-Knowing and All-Wise, assuring that divine wisdom will ultimately restore what was lost.
